title: Humaans Product Update: Improved Employment Terms and Performance cycles, automatic relationship fields, and much more…
summary: This month’s updates help keep your people data accurate and processes consistent, with improved employment record capabilities, automatic relationship assignments and personalized performance cycle experiences.
body_markdown:
As your organisation grows, keeping your people data accurate and processes consistent takes increasingly more work. This month’s updates help reduce that effort, with improved employment record capabilities, automatic relationship assignments and personalized performance cycle experiences.


**Further customise your Employment Terms**


Employment details can change many times throughout someone’s time at your organisation. We’ve improved Employment terms to make it easier to track changes over time, maintain a clear employment history, and schedule future updates with effective dates.


To allow further customization, we have moved employment terms section from Employee profile, into a new card below that brings even more key employment details together in one place, making it easier to:


- Track and manage employment information changes over time, with separate fields for employment type, contract type, and work arrangement.
- Add your own custom fields to capture details like contract renewal dates, with values saved alongside each set of terms to preserve their history.
- Better support remote work by recording full working addresses and optionally associating remote employees with an office.


We'll automatically migrate your existing employment information to the new structure, so there's nothing you’ll need to do to prepare.


**Keep relationship assignments up to date with automatic fields**


Automatically assign relationships fields, so as your organisation grows and changes, your data stays up to date and your team spends less time manually maintaining records and routing requests.


- Set rules for fields such as People partner or skip-level manager, based on department, country or contract type.
- Define priority rules and fallbacks to keep assignments accurate as people move teams or roles.
- Use these fields to route requests directly to the right approver.


**Make performance cycles easier to navigate**


Each person now sees the performance cycles relevant to their responsibilities, based on your existing roles, teams and Spaces, helping keep performance reviews on track.


- Managers see their team’s cycles, reviewers see those they contribute to, and custom roles see cycles within their scope.
- Cycle menus show the actions available at each stage, from scheduling to completion.
- Download individual reviews directly from a cycle.


**Share people data and engagement insights more easily**


Bring people data and survey findings into leadership discussions and wider reporting, so you can spend less time preparing reports and more time discussing what it means and how to action these insights.


- Export any table to Excel for further analysis and reporting.
- Download an Engagement AI report as a PNG to share survey insights


**Other improvements**


- **Faster AI Companion:** An even faster model helps your AI Companion credits go further.
- **Conditional steps after a task in Workflows:** conditional steps can now wait for an earlier task to be completed, like the other steps in a workflow already can.
- **Choose when those offboarding lose access: e** ach provisioning integration now has a "Deprovision at" setting, so you can pick what time someone's accounts are switched off on their last day, in their own timezone.
- **An improved engagement feedback tab:** the Comments tab is now called Feedback. It highlights comments and written answers to open-ended questions together, with the same search, filters, AI summaries and themes.


We hope you find these updates useful! If you have any feedback or challenges to share, feel free to reach out. We're here to help.
